Perusal of the Case Diary as well as taking note of the conduct of the accused in cooperating with the investigating agency this Court is of the opinion that custodial interrogation of the petitioner may not be necessary for further investigation of this case.

Accordingly, the present bail application stands allowed in terms of the interim order dated 19.11.2025 with a further condition that the petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and when called for and he will cooperate with the investigation and shall not tamper or hamper and influence any witnesses that may be vital for the investigation.
